evidence.criterion: O1: The evaluation pauses because the current bar is too fuzzy and the supplied template creates an unresolved judgment-versus-conformance conflict.

human_labels.judge_rationale: The artifact correctly pauses, rejects the fuzzy bar, and avoids treating the template as ground truth without conformance confirmation. It fails to require surfacing the skill’s first principles and fails to require echoing the resolved mode and per-case bar before launching blind runners.

observations.value: Stop and ask the user to define a real per-case bar: the intended outcome and specific failure smells. “Make it good” is too vague, and the exact template should not be used as a proxy unless the user confirms this is a conformance-style skill.
